title: Kraus map closed-form solution for general master equation dynamics
summary: The Kraus representation of quantum channels allows for a precise emulation of the complex dynamics that take place on quantum processors, whether for benchmarking algorithms, predicting the performance of error correction and mitigation, or in the myriad other uses of compiled digital sequences. Nonetheless, starting from first principles to obtain continuous quantum master equations involves various approximations such as weak coupling to the environment.
